race.title: Play Coral 'Racing-Super-Series' For Free 'National Hunt' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 2)
race.verdict: STICK TO THE BOARD failed to land the odds on his Chepstow hurdling debut but was still a promising first effort in this sphere in a race that's worked out well, and he's taken to go one better with the return to 2m unlikely to inconvenience him. Octo Gane and useful bumper performer Tally Ho Back head the dangers. STICK TO THE BOARD (IRE) OCTO GANE (FR) TALLY HO BACK
race.bettingForecast: Stick To The Board (7/4), Tally Ho Back (5/2), Dead Cert (7/2), Octo Gane (11/2), Duhallow Storm (6/1), Ashes And Arrows (10/1), Jetaway Holiday (14/1), Jaycee Reidy (20/1), Plan De Stan (25/1), Rock On Ronnie (25/1), Unbelievable Jeff (100/1), Days Of Joy (100/1), Our Rarest Hour (200/1)
